scripts.build: npm ci --prefix admin && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.check: node --check worker/src/index.js && node --check worker/src/auth.js && node --check worker/src/locations.js && node --check worker/src/batches.js && node --check worker/src/qrs.js && node --check worker/src/qr-render.js && node --check worker/src/activation.js && node --check worker/src/cloudflare-usage.js && node --check scripts/deploy-template.mjs

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Set a long randomly generated setup token (16+ chars). Keep it private and enter it only in the first admin setup form.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Set a unique randomly generated secret of at least 32 characters used for admin session cookies.

ACTIVATION_SECRET.description: Set a DIFFERENT random secret of at least 32 characters for QR activation HMAC verification.
